title: Data Protection Analyst (1785)
description:
Join Our Team at Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC

At Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC, we are proud to be a global leader and innovator in the direct selling industry, with more than 50 years of sustained growth and meaningful impact across 7 countries.

Our people are the heart of our success. We embrace the unique experiences, cultural backgrounds, and perspectives that each team member brings—because we know that diversity drives innovation and connection. By fostering an inclusive environment built on trust, support, and authenticity, we’re able to better understand and serve our distributors and customers around the world.

We are looking for our next: Data Protection Analyst in Barueri, São Paulo, Brazil

What The Role Involves

The Data Protection Analyst will be a valued collaborator across Legal, IT, and Information Security functions, supporting global data privacy and cybersecurity standards including LGPD, CPRA, GLBA, and NYDFS Reg 500. This person will engage with teams across regions and disciplines to help embed legal requirements into everyday practices through project support, training, and thoughtful documentation.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Support business and IT projects by reviewing proposed data use, identifying privacy and cybersecurity requirements, assisting with Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and helping resolve identified risks.
  • Partner with Legal, IT, and Compliance to ensure regulatory requirements are considered early in project planning—helping prevent costly rework, missed deadlines, and scope changes.
  • Support vendor oversight by maintaining an inventory of required privacy and security terms in standard contracts, tracking approved deviations, and identifying which vendors process personal data (PII). Coordinate with Legal to flag gaps and support ongoing vendor risk management.
  • Triage and respond to incoming questions about data privacy and security; maintain clear documentation of actions and decisions.
  • Monitor and assess digital tracking practices (e.g., website cookies) for compliance with global requirements.
  • Support privacy governance tools (e.g., BigID, OneTrust) by helping ensure legal requirements are reflected in data inventories, records of processing, and risk documentation.
  • Support responses to Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and related compliance reporting.
  • Help develop and deliver internal training to promote awareness and understanding of data privacy and legal requirements related to cybersecurity.
  • Follow all legal and compliance policies and report any potential issues or breaches.

What We’re Looking For

  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year institution.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience, ideally in privacy, data governance, or security roles.
  • Working knowledge of regulations such as LGPD, CPRA, and NYDFS Reg 500.
  • Familiarity with tools like OneTrust or BigID is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between legal, business, and technical teams.
  • Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage deadlines and work with cross-functional teams.
  • CIPP certification is a plus.
  • Fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is strongly preferred.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about protecting data, collaborating across global teams, and growing your career in a purpose-driven environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of our inclusive team.

Hy Cite is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, recognizing that it builds stronger teams. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take our responsibility seriously to consider qualified applicants on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expressions, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, marital status, citizenship, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by applicable law.

Job Description
The Supply Chain Manager will be responsible for Planning, Scheduling, Procurement, and Inventory Management to support production and distribution needs. This role requires a strategic thinker who can drive operational efficiency, optimize inventory, and ensure seamless coordination between suppliers, manufacturing, and distribution.
Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes to align demand and supply.
  • Create production schedules that balance efficiency, capacity, and demand fluctuations.
  • Work closely with manufacturing, sales, and logistics teams to optimize scheduling and minimize downtime.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as on-time delivery, schedule adherence, and capacity utilization.
  • Develop and execute procurement strategies to optimize cost, quality, and lead times.
  • Negotiate contracts and maintain strong relationships with vendors and suppliers.
  • Ensure raw materials and packaging availability while mitigating supply chain risks.
  • Monitor supplier performance, addressing issues related to delivery, cost, or quality.
  • Implement inventory control processes to optimize stock levels and minimize waste.
  • Ensure raw materials and finished goods inventory align with demand forecasts and production plans.
  • Work with warehouse and logistics teams to improve inventory accuracy and reduce excess/obsolete stock.
  • Leverage data analytics to enhance decision-making and inventory forecasting.
  • Issue purchase orders and address receipt variances with vendors.
  • Maintain the vendor master data in the ERP.

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Operations, Business, or related field.
  • 5-10 years of experience in supply chain roles within food manufacturing or CPG industries.
  • Strong understanding of production planning, procurement, and inventory management best practices.
  • Experience with ERP/MRP systems and data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent negotiation, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Knowledge of food safety regulations, USDA/FDA compliance, and supply chain sustainability is a plus.

O Enfermeiro CTI Adulto é responsável pelo planejamento, sistematização e execução da assistência de enfermagem, incluída a supervisão dos técnicos de enfermagem, aos pacientes graves, visando a garantia da qualidade e segurança no transcorrer de intervenções no Hospital Mãe de Deus, sempre em consonância com a Missão, Visão e Valores éticos, morais e humanos, fundamentados nos valores da Congregação das Irmãs Missionárias de São Carlos Borromeo Scalabrinianas.

  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem aos pacientes críticos, por meio de assessoria técnica, negociação e resolução de problemas, suporte para equipe multiprofissional, atendimento e manejo das intercorrências, fornecimento de informações ao paciente e à família, e interface com áreas de apoio;
  • Garantir a execução de procedimentos privativos e de responsabilidade do Enfermeiro, através da aplicação de técnicas de enfermagem, acompanhamento de procedimentos invasivos de maior complexidade executados pelo médico, e da supervisão da equipe e técnicos de enfermagem;

  • Assegurar aos pacientes e familiares informações sobre os procedimentos e cuidados de enfermagem, por meio de orientações e educação do paciente e família.

Sobre o Stark Bank

Você se imagina trabalhando em uma empresa que antecipa o futuro simplificando o presente? Esse é o Stark Bank, banco das empresas que vem crescendo exponencialmente no Brasil.

Nascemos em 2018 e oferecemos a melhor tecnologia para gestão financeira de pagamentos e recebimentos. Temos orgulho de dizer que nossos desenvolvedores criaram uma das APIs mais completas e amigáveis do mercado para oferecer produtos financeiros de forma inovadora.

Apesar de sermos jovens, somos lucrativos desde 2020 e estamos na Serie B, com grandes investidores por trás. Somos a primeira startup brasileira a receber investimentos de um fundo privado do Jeff Bezos, o fundador da Amazon!

Buscamos pessoas que entendam como encantar clientes internos, queiram quebrar recordes e fazer história, construindo o melhor banco do universo!

Sobre a posição:

No time de riscos, você será responsável pela elaboração de indicadores, monitoramento e análise de riscos financeiros e de gestão de capital do Stark Bank, garantindo a conformidade com as regulamentações vigentes.

Você estará à frente da implementação de modelos de avaliação de risco, projeções de capital e análise de impactos financeiros em cenários macroeconômicos e regulatórios!

Você irá:
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de riscos de mercado, crédito e liquidez, com foco em capital e adequação regulatória (Basileia III, por exemplo);
  • Desenvolver e manter ferramentas e modelos de análise de risco, incluindo ferramentas quantitativas e de visualização de dados, para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas;
  • Gerenciar o cálculo e a projeção de requisitos de capital do banco, com base nas metodologias estabelecidas e mudanças regulatórias;
  • Monitorar e avaliar o impacto de eventos macroeconômicos e alterações regulatórias nos requisitos de capital do banco;
  • Desenvolver modelos e cenários de stress test para simulação de variáveis de risco em diferentes cenários financeiros;
  • Preparar relatórios periódicos para a alta direção e órgãos reguladores, apresentando análises, conclusões e recomendações sobre o risco de capital;
  • Acompanhar e aplicar mudanças na regulamentação de capital e adequação financeira, incluindo as mudanças previstas nas políticas do Bacen e demais órgãos reguladores;
  • Apoiar as áreas internas na definição de estratégias de mitigação de riscos financeiros, colaborando com outras áreas, como Produtos, Tesouraria, Crédito e Compliance.
O que não pode faltar:
  • Formação superior em Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Gestão de Riscos ou áreas afins será um diferencial;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em funções similares, com forte atuação em gestão de risco financeiro, análise de capital e regulação bancária;
  • Profundo conhecimento das normas de adequação de capital (Basileia III), métricas de risco e gestão de capital regulatório;
  • Habilidades analíticas e quantitativas para avaliar cenários de risco e realizar projeções de capital sob diferentes condições econômicas;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e assertiva, tanto para apresentações para a alta direção quanto para relatórios técnicos;
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas e de modelagem financeira;
  • Inglês avançado.

We’re proud of the work we do, and we do it within a culture that is open, honest, and cooperative. We have a history of attracting visionary people who embrace challenges and deliver creative solutions for every project, and your voice is an important part of the conversation.

title: Assistente de Logística
description:
Job description

Será que você é o ingrediente que falta por aqui?

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa apaixonada por organização, distribuição e entrega , para integrar o nosso time de Logística .

Na Pif Paf Alimentos, você vai fazer parte de um time diverso, dinâmico e criativo . Trabalhamos com muita colaboração e troca de experiências entre todas as áreas no comum desejo de tornar a vida das pessoas do Brasil e do mundo mais saborosa.

Se identificou? Então venha fazer parte da nossa receita de sucesso: #VemSerPifPaf!


Main responsibilities

Olha só como você vai contribuir com o time de Logística :

Monitorando as viagens através do sistema SAP integrado com tecnologias de rastreamento de veículos a fim de acompanhar as entregas em tempo real garantindo o atendimento e a satisfação dos clientes da empresa;

Realizando a tratativa de reclamações, devoluções de produtos, contribuindo para uma melhor efetividade das entregas;

Emitindo relatórios diários encaminhando para o Líder e Coordenador de Logística realizar análises e aprovações no sistema;

Auxiliando na análise dos fretes realizados, via sistema Tranportation, acompanhando as emissões dos conhecimentos eletrônicos junto aos Parceiros da Companhia (Cooperativas e Transportadoras);

Apoiando no controle dos pagamentos de fretes de acordo com as tabelas aprovadas, observando prazos de pagamentos e de entregas, a fim de que os fretes tenham o menor custo, sem prejudicar a qualidade do fornecimento e a satisfação dos clientes.


Requirements and skills

Para mandar bem, você precisa apresentar:

Ensino Médio Completo;

Conhecimento do Pacote Office - nível intermediário (foco em Excel);

Graduação em andamento em Logística, Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins;

Conhecimento do SAP - diferencial;

Disponibilidade para viagens - desejável.


Additional information

Fazendo parte do nosso time, você tem como benefícios:

Ticket Alimentação: para quem gosta de preparar a própria comida ou fazer aquela comprinha;

Plano de saúde com coparticipação : para você e seus dependentes, visando o bem-estar e saúde;

Plano Odontológico : para que possamos continuar sorrindo à toa com a saúde bucal em dia;

️ Wellhub (academia): para cuidar da sua saúde e corpo;

Cooperativa de Crédito: para te auxiliar a conquistar os seus sonhos;

Vida Bem-vinda: programa de apoio a gestantes e futuros papais;

Facilidade, praticidade e descontos em produtos Pif Paf: aplicativo interno para compra de produtos com entrega rápida;

Parcerias para desconto em cursos e graduação : para quem deseja conquistar aquele tão sonhado diploma;

Seguro de Vida em Grupo : apoio nos momentos em que você mais precisa;

Kit Natalino com produtos Pif Paf: para deixar a sua comemoração ainda mais saborosa.

Como será o processo?

As primeiras etapas do nosso processo seletivo são feitas aqui na plataforma Gupy . Você terá todos os retornos por e-mail, combinado? Fique de olho na sua caixa de entrada ou spam, para acompanhar sua evolução no processo.

É bom saber: Aqui, na Pif Paf Alimentos queremos que, cada vez mais, as pessoas se sintam representadas e incluídas. Por isso, contamos com o Vozes, nosso Programa de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão . Gostaríamos de receber em nosso time mais pessoas de diversas gerações, raças, etnias, classes sociais, gêneros, público LGBTI+ e pessoas com deficiência.

Curtiu? Então #VemSerPifPaf .

In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.

  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

A Pessoa Coordenadora de Desenvolvimento de Liderança será responsável pela construção e fortalecimento da liderança do Bem Estar Bem na Natura. Isso significa criar e implementar programas e ações que impulsionem nossos líderes a crescerem, se desenvolverem e entregarem resultados alinhados aos nossos comportamentos desejados. Somos um movimento que transforma a maneira de viver e fazer negócios em 14 países da América Latina, sempre guiados por consciência.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Ebury is a leading global fintech company that empowers businesses to trade and grow internationally. It offers a comprehensive suite of products, including international payments and collections, FX risk management, trade finance, and API integrations. Founded in 2009 by Juan Lobato and Salvador García, Ebury is one of the fastest-growing global fintechs, with over 1,700 employees and 38 offices in more than 25 countries.

São Paulo Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer that is in line with the technological stack we use. If you don't have full adherence, don't worry, we like the diversity of knowledge and you can certainly learn a lot from our team. As part of the team, you will be responsible for helping to build an Engineering Platform aligned with the guidelines of our global team at Ebury.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Discretionary bonus based on performance
  • Continuous personal development through training and certification
  • We are Open Source friendly, following Open Source principles in our internal projects and encouraging contributions to external projects

How we work today:

  • Product-oriented multidisciplinary teams.
  • Scalable architecture oriented towards microservices.
  • Microservices written in GoLang, Python, Kotlin, Node.js, and React.
  • High processing capacity with intercommunication using GRPC/Kafka.
  • Continuous integration and deployment in Google Cloud (GCP).
  • Automation using GIT, Jenkins, Spinnaker, Ansible, and Terraform.
  • Data persistence in DataStore.
  • Monitoring based on 'observability' techniques using Prometheus.
  • Immutable infrastructure with containers managed via Kubernetes.

Responsibilities of the Senior Platform Engineering Role:

  • Discuss and help define service owners created in GCP (Google Cloud) for the business through a RACI Matrix.
  • Define and create centralized access management controls for resources created by teams in GCP (Google Cloud).
  • Implement a robust integration and shutdown process with the integration of access request and approval workflows through automations in JIRA.
  • Help define and deploy a standardized baseline for creating new projects to avoid the recurring proliferation of non-standard projects within the company.
  • Develop standardized guidelines for creating new projects, covering naming conventions, resource allocations, and configurations.

On Security:

  • Design and implement monitoring controls for access to keys and their related functions.
  • Introduce a comprehensive RBAC system within GCP, ensuring that users and service accounts receive permissions strictly based on their roles and responsibilities following the Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP).
  • Governance and creation of guardrails for platform self-service automation;
  • Governance and creation of 'Golden Paths' automation for engineering teams;
  • Governance and creation of observability for resources created through the engineering platform.

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • A business level of English and Spanish would be a plus.
  • Analytical, resilient, and multitasking profile.
  • Management capability.
  • Experience facilitating the adoption of IT standards and processes.
  • Advanced knowledge of OS (Linux).
  • Aptitude for scripting programming and IaC (Infrastructure as Code).
  • Knowledge in Networking (TCP/IP, Firewall, DNS, Routing, etc.).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD (Tools such as: GitHub, Github Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD. Practices: Build, test, push, deploy stages).
  • Orchestration of plugins and addons (K8S, EKS, GKE, Kops, Kubespray, Rancher, Helm, Nginx Ingress Controller or equivalent).
  • Knowledge of Observability using tools such as: (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, AlertManager, Kiali, ELK Stack, Loki, DataDog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, CloudWatch, StackDriver, OpenTelemetry, New Relic). To generate and track: Metrics, Logging, Application Tracing.

If you’re excited about this job opportunity but your background doesn’t match exactly the requirements in the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other positions we have.

At Ebury Bank we value diversity in all its forms and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. All of our vacancies are open and eligible for people with disabilities.

title: Senior Lead Technology Architect - Lyric Team
description:
Description

ADP is hiring a Senior Lead Technology Architect - Lyric Team

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking tojoin a dynamic, inclusiveteam environmentwith a culture of collaboration and belonging?

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you will be the person who keeps our team on track and on time for new projects. Working alongside 7 to 14 team members, you remove roadblocks and keep developers coding. Whether it's coaching, cutting meetings short, or auditing the process - you'll do whatever it takes to keep the project moving.

To thrive in this role, you must understand the software development project lifecycle in an Agile environment have prior project management experience working in scrums or as a scrum master. Ideally, you've managed a project from inception to production at an enterprise level. Our best project managers show initiative, try new things and learn from their mistakes along the way. PMP certification is not required. You must be comfortable enough with code to decipher functions, and a technical coding background will help you be successful.As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges,get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

Experience and Skills:

  • Solid experience in leading & managing multiple complex projects in agile environments (both Scrum and Kanban);
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills and be able to communicate and adapt effectively to different audiences (team, management, executive, business etc);
  • Project & Process Management skills, including industry standard project management;
  • Experience in Project Management Tools such as Jira, MS SharePoint, Webex and MS Office & Project;
  • Experience working with offshore teams and project teams distributed across multiple time zones;
  • Strong knowledge of NodeJS, Java, Springboot, Kafka, PostegresSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, Kubernets, Splunk;
  • Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
  • Advanced English;
  • Proven experience dealing with challenging team members / personnel issues. On occasion you will be co-managing team members when managers are either remote (other countries) or are not directly involved in the project;
  • Excellent presentation skills and be able to present project updates in front of small or large groups.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Scrums. You'll start each day with a scrum, working with a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities;
  • Coding. Working in two-week agile sprints, you must keep up with timelines and coding standards. Although your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time, you may need to dive in to review code, so your coding background will come in handy and contribute to your success;
  • Communications. You're the point of contact for the project. You'll share information with your teammates, mark milestones, and provide metrics and status updates to product owners and project sponsors;
  • Organization. As a project manager, you are very organized, and you keep everyone on task. Is a meeting going off-topic? You'll pull the team back to the agenda. Scope creeping? You'll stay on top of the schedule, remove barriers, identify dependencies, and mitigate risks;
  • Variety of tasks. There is no typical day. You could coach a teammate, deliver a status update to executives in other departments, or make sure we have deployed our resources in the best possible way. You will manage many competing priorities, so a fast pace should not scare you. You pride yourself on having flexibility and agility and can change directions without a second thought;
  • Servant Leadership. Your job is to help everyone else work better. What tasks or issues can you handle so your development team can keep working? What barriers can you remove?;

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity;
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes;
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft;
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation;
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!

As a Solutions Engineer in São Paulo, you will work closely with Sales and Account Management teams to drive success for Taboola’s advertisers. You will be responsible for onboarding new Advertisers, monitoring delivery and performance, resolving technical issues, and providing in-depth technical recommendations, and optimization strategies across a book of business. This includes troubleshooting complex database and backend technology issues.

The Solutions Engineer possesses great communication and presentation skills, and ability to understand all technical aspects of our client’s goal and objectives. The Solutions Engineer should be a fast learner and able to ramp up on the changing needs of the platform. Continuous learning and adaptability to change are critical parts of the job.

To thrive in this role, you'll need:
  • 2+ years of experience in a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager role
  • Experience working experience with SQL, JavaScript, and basic HTML
  • Experience working experience with Google Analytics and APIs
  • Experience working with Google Tag Manager or other tag management systems
  • Proven ability to strategically evaluate and drive client success through sales techniques such as effective questioning, objection handling, and strong customer service skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, and ability to translate technical investigations and analysis into actions for non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to run simple Data analysis and comparisons.
Bonus points if you have:
  • Experience with the ecosystem of ad networks, DSPs, audience targeting and technology, ad operations and ad buying
  • Experience with mobile measurement partners (e.g., Appsflyer, Adjust, Kochava, Branch)
  • Experience in tracking implementation methods (e.g., Shopify, DCM)
How you’ll make an impact:

As a Solutions Engineer you will:

  • Own responsibility for end-to-end technical onboarding processes, Taboola pixel implementation, conversion tracking, performance and health analysis.
  • Perform technical troubleshooting to identify and proactively solve issues.
  • Perform end-to-end campaign performance analysis, and provide delivery and optimization recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and clients, to increase revenue and KPI attainment.
  • Design methodologies and tools to improve customer service and troubleshooting ability
  • Build an in-depth knowledge of Taboola advertising products, and how they can be used to meet a wide range of marketing objectives.
  • Act as a technical expert on attribution and measurement, providing guidance on best practices, privacy-compliant tracking and data integration
  • Lead the technical integration of tracking and data collection tools across advertiser accounts, ensuring seamless implementation and data accuracy
  • Build technical solutions and automation workflows to scale measurement capabilities
  • Set up and manage data pipelines to collect, process, and analyze campaign performance data.
Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:

  • Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.
  • Well-being: Enjoy comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401k matching), pre-tax commuter benefits, a fully stocked kitchen, and various gym partnerships.
  • Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.
  • Work with some of the biggest names: We work with some of the biggest names in the business. Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, Expedia and Honda.

Ready to realize your potential?

Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn , Facebook , Instagram , X , YouTube , & the Taboola Life Blog .

About Taboola

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers' objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:

  • Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical
  • Focus - Large companies with established ARR
  • Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers
All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers.
Location: This role will be based remotely.
What your day will look like
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers and decision makers from various industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales.
  • Experience running a disciplined, weekly customer and business review process with cross-functional teams, identifying and prioritizing blockers, and driving resolution through corporate product and engineering teams
  • Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical products roadmaps, Canonical websites, documentation, processes and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.
  • Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
What we are looking for in you
The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.
  • Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.
  • A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies.
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus!
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English).

title: ESPECIALISTA GARANTIA QUALIDADE
description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar planos e processos de controle de qualidade.
  • Realizar auditorias de qualidade nos processos de produção e serviços oferecidos pela empresa.
  • Criar e executar testes para garantir que os produtos e sistemas atendam aos requisitos técnicos e de qualidade.
  • Identificar, analisar e reportar não conformidades e propor ações corretivas.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes de desenvolvimento, produção e outras áreas para garantir a melhoria contínua.
  • Manter e revisar documentos e registros de qualidade, como relatórios de testes, certificações e auditorias.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas regulamentares e padrões da indústria relacionados à qualidade.
  • Treinar e orientar outros membros da equipe sobre processos e melhores práticas de qualidade.
  • Analisar feedbacks de clientes e outras partes interessadas, implementando ações para melhorias.

Apoiar processos comerciais em novos contratos e renovações contratuais para beneficiar usinas que apresentam características do produto favoráveis ao giro de vagões e penalizar desfavoráveis. Definir e elaborar procedimentos de recebimento / recusa e bloqueio / desbloqueio de cargas, usinas e clientes.

Possibilitar aumento de volume, produtividade e receita através de interface e apoio técnico de qualidade com comercial e cliente de curto, médio e longo prazo, elaboração de planos, acompanhamento e controle do blend de produtos conforme demanda (novos produtos ou fora de especificação).

Definir e gerir planos de recuperação dos indicadores críticos para atendimento da conformidade com as especificações exigidas de produto (cor, compactação, cinzas, pol...), processo (FIFO, tempo de descanso, despoeiramento) e produtividade (TMD) no curto, médio e longo prazo através da inspeção dos produtos movimentados nos portos e terminais.

Qualificações

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Engenharia Química, de Alimentos, de Produção ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência prévia na área de Garantia de Qualidade (QA), Controle de Qualidade e análises em operações com produto açúcar ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias e ferramentas de testes, como testes manuais, automação de testes, controle de versões e sistemas de gestão de qualidade.
  • Familiaridade com padrões de qualidade como ISO 9001, ISO 17025, Six Sigma, entre outros.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e elaboração de relatórios.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidades interpessoais.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em ambientes multidisciplinares.
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de testes e CI/CD (Integração Contínua/Entrega Contínua).

Informações adicionais

Ser responsável pelo fluxo do produto açúcar, desde o recebimento rodoviário nos terminais (incluindo as interfaces com usinas e clientes) até a entrega nos portos / navio. Estabelecer e acompanhar parâmetros e indicadores de conformidade do produto movimentado (rodo, ferro, armazenagem e embarque), visando aderência às normas oficiais, aos padrões estabelecidos, às especificações dos clientes, boas práticas de manipulação e aos indicadores de produtividade da LDC. Acompanhamento em inspeções, vistorias e auditorias de órgãos públicos e sistema de gestão de qualidade e realização de auditorias do sistema de gestão de qualidade e ISO 9001, ISO 17025.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

Com mais de seis décadas de experiência desde nossa fundação em 1959, somos uma força impulsionadora na logística nacional. Buscamos um profissional para atuar como Operador de Expedição em nossa unidade localizada em Recife/PE .
Missão do Cargo: Executar as atividades operacionais de separação, movimentação e carregamento de produtos, assegurando que os processos de expedição ocorram com agilidade, precisão e segurança, conforme os padrões estabelecidos pelo cliente.
PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:
  • Separação e Preparação de Cargas:
Realizar a separação de produtos conforme ordens de carregamento ou romaneios, garantindo o correto empilhamento e identificação para expedição.
  • Movimentação de Produtos:
Efetuar a movimentação física dos produtos (ensacados ou granel, conforme o tipo de operação), utilizando carrinhos hidráulicos, paleteiras ou equipamentos de movimentação (se habilitado).
  • Carregamento de Veículos:
Auxiliar no carregamento de caminhões, respeitando os critérios de segurança, empilhamento correto e disposição da carga conforme orientações do conferente.
  • Organização do Pátio e Doca:
Manter a área de expedição organizada, com os produtos posicionados adequadamente para facilitar o fluxo logístico e evitar avarias.
  • Apoio na Conferência:
Apoiar o conferente na verificação de quantidades e integridade dos volumes, garantindo que o que está sendo carregado corresponda ao pedido do cliente.
  • Zelar pela Segurança nas Operações:
Cumprir rigorosamente as normas de segurança, utilizar corretamente os EPIs, sinalizar áreas de risco e colaborar com a prevenção de acidentes.
  • Controle de Paletes e Embalagens:
Realizar o manuseio correto de paletes, bags ou outras embalagens utilizadas no transporte de cimento, contribuindo para o controle e conservação desses materiais.
  • Limpeza e Conservação do Ambiente de Trabalho:
Executar rotinas de limpeza da área de expedição e zelar pela conservação dos equipamentos e ferramentas utilizados.
REQUISITOS DESEJAVÉIS:
  • Experiência com operações logísticas de cargas pesadas;
  • Noções de segurança do trabalho em ambientes industriais/logísticos;
  • Desejável conhecimento em expedição de cimento ensacado ou a granel;
  • Habilitação para operação de empilhadeira (caso atue com esse equipamento).

Join to apply for the Senior Sales Solutions Architect - West (Azure) (RapidScale) role at RapidScale

Our Sales SA positions will require 25-35% travel to conferences, partner offices, and customer sites.
This role will support opportunities on the west coast.
At RapidScale, exceptional technology is powered by exceptional people. As a growing leader in secure, reliable managed cloud solutions, we help SMBs and enterprises alike simplify IT and unleash innovation. With a broad portfolio spanning AWS, Azure and Google to a full set of Private Cloud and Cybersecurity solutions, RapidScale helps companies turn technology into their biggest competitive advantage. As part of the Cox family of companies, we offer best-in-class benefits, a commitment to work-life balance, and an award-winning workplace experience.
What does the Sales Solutions Architecture Team do?
Sales Solution Architects work in partnership with Solutions Specialists (Sales Representatives) and serve as their technical counterparts in all phases of the sales lifecycle. From evangelizing technologies to demonstrating our feature-rich Cloud Reliability Platform, our job is to help customers figure out and solve their cloud initiatives. We do this by taking a consultative approach in our discovery and assessment phases with the output being solutions that are built with reliability, performance, and security baked-in on top of our Managed Cloud Portfolio. As an integral part of the Solutions Architecture team, you will design systems that are purpose-built and well suited to their target infrastructure.
What You'll Do
As a Solution Architect you will:

  • Provide Pre-Sales technical support to the GTM Team to drive revenue and cloud adoption
  • Conduct full technical discovery and assessment workshops to identify pain points and gather business and technical requirements. This will include Well-Architected Reviews, Migration Readiness Assessments, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis, etc.
  • You will architect client solutions to meet client requirements using a well architected framework methodology
  • Clearly communicate proposed architectures in the pre-sales cycle for early validation and verification to the internal teams responsible for implementing and providing ongoing support
  • Be a technology evangelist and educate prospects and customers on the cloud solution that makes the most sense for their business and technology requirements
  • Interface with Product Marketing and provide feedback for improving product quality and capabilities by leveraging information gathered in field engagements
  • Collaborate in the creation of technical collateral (e.g. SOWs, HLDs), and help develop sales staff by providing formal training
  • Produce cost and labor estimates and SOWs for potential projects
  • Provide thought leadership by speaking at industry events such as trade shows, panels or marketing events as well as publishing blog posts, white papers and participating in case studies
What Technical Attributes We're Looking For In You
  • Relevant Industry-leading certification required: AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect - Expert)
  • Deep understanding of the following Public Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure, AWS
  • Understanding of containerization & virtualization technologies; e.g Kubernetes, Docker
  • Understanding of IAAS / PAAS / SAAS platforms; e.g. EC2, VMs, etc.
  • Understanding IaC tools; e.g. Puppet, Ansible, ARM/Bicep, Terraform
  • Understanding of different Disaster Recovery and data protection principles
  • Understanding of PCI, HIPAA, GDPR regulatory compliance frameworks
  • Understanding of Relational and Non-Relational Databases (MySQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server, NoSQL)
  • Expertise in networking, compute, storage and OS fundamentals
What General Attributes We're Looking For In You
Ideal candidate must be enthusiastic, a self-starter, and willing to step up to new challenges. Must be comfortable in the dynamic atmosphere of a technical organization with a rapidly expanding customer base.
  • A BA/BS Degree with 6+ years of experience, or a MS Degree with 4+ years of experience, or a Ph.D with one year of experience, or 10 years of overall experience without a degree
  • Background and experience working in the context of a sales team
  • Strong presentation, written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong analytical problem-solving ability
  • High level of comfort communicating effectively across internal organizations
  • Ability to speak at public events in front of large audiences is a bonus
  • Fluency in English is a must
Successful Contributors Display The Following Personality Traits
  • They're intensely curious while displaying analytical, problem-solving, and dot-connecting skills with the ability to develop quick, accurate situational awareness
  • They display strong communication and presentation skills, both oral and written and are comfortable with individual and group presentations
  • They have cultivated strong interpersonal skills and have experience initiating and building positive relationships
  • They are comfortable within a rapidly changing technical environment and are comfortable with ambiguity
What makes this an exciting opportunity?
Working at a high-growth company is exciting on many levels. You'll have wide latitude to grow your technical skills and the company actively encourages learning and pays you to gain industry recognized certifications. You'll find unusually broad opportunities to expand your knowledge and grow your career. New ideas and lateral thinking are the norm, and you'll find your team and other cross-functional groups are receptive to them, because everything you do here is visible and matters. We are in an industry (the hyper cloud) that is doing cool stuff and the pace-of-change creates exponential areas of growth opportunity - both personally and professionally.

title: Operations & Logistics Sr Manager, Brazil
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talented team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels inspired, invested, cared for, valued, and have a strong sense of belonging.


What You Can Expect

As a senior member of the Brazil Commercial Operations team, this position is responsible for leading all aspects of the Commercial Operations function and its associated team in the country. The role holds full accountability for Demand Planning, Distribution, Customer Service, Inventory Management, and Operational Excellence in Brazil. Working in close partnership with the local Commercial leadership, this position is accountable for achieving functional goals related to customer service levels, forecast accuracy, inventory and asset performance, and for meeting cash flow objectives within the commercial P&L and related cost centers.In support of the Brazil Commercial Head and local business leaders, this role will also drive the use of Integrated Business Planning processes and tools to improve operational performance and cost efficiency, while aligning with the company’s global strategic priorities and transformation initiatives.

How You'll Create Impact

  • Leadership of the regional Supply Chain, Customer Service, Warehousing, Loaner Management and Distribution teams, ensuring SLAs and targets are met, KPIs are in place and all processes and centres are running at optimum efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Work closely with the Executive leadership to develop, propose and execute Customer Centric Supply Chain strategies that support the business and aim to provide competitive advantage in all areas of the Commercial Operations function.
  • Lead and grow Talent, including hiring, advancing, and retaining Talent within own region and in collaboration with the other Functions and HR. Own the regional Talent pool.
  • Own the execution of all Transformation related programs and projects in said area of responsibility as they relate to processes, people, footprint and technology.
  • Assure the delivery of correct Demand Plans that will enable the market to meet sales and service objectives. Own and execute all elements of the IBP process for the region.
  • Maintain high standards of Health & Safety across the region in accordance with the Company’s Health & Safety policy. Ensure departmental procedures support corporate quality & compliance requirements. Perform all activities in compliance with relevant Quality System standards.
  • Support and drive Product Life Cycle management & product rationalization execution to ensure smooth & well communicated market launch and exit of pre-defined product lines.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Life Science and/or Medical Devices industry experience
  • Demonstrated & detailed level of knowledge and understanding of complex global Supply Chains.
  • Ability to operate independently and use judgment for high impact decisions.
  • Ability to simplify a complex supply chain, while considering global & regional tax implications
  • Demonstrated experience successfully leading and engaging teams across multiple locations within region.
  • Demonstrates effective written and oral communication and presentation skills, ability to interact with senior management.
  • Strong analytical skills, along with strong experience with analytics toolsets (Excel, Tableau)
  • Demonstrated Commercial Operations Strategy skills, with an ability to define and implement strategic initiatives
  • Understanding of strategic cost issues and uses range of techniques for cost reduction to meet targets.
  • Strong Financial acumen, with a solid understanding of Financial Statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash-Flows)
  • Ability to engage in contract negotiations and develop contracts on a national or regional basis; create basic project plans and manger source plan and implementation across functions and sites.
  • Comprehensive knowledge in job related functional area.
  • Conflict resolution, people development, delegation, and cultural sensitivity.
  • Strong background in process and change management.

Your Background

  • Excellent command of English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Over 10 years of relevant experience in similar operations roles, including proven leadership in operations management.
  • Preferably experienced in MedTech, ideally in orthopedics; however, backgrounds in other medical device areas (e.g., neuro) are also valued.
  • Strong financial acumen, with hands-on experience managing P&L, balance sheets, cash flow, and cost centers.
  • Proficiency with advanced supply chain systems and technologies (e.g., SAP, APO, or similar platforms).

Travel Expectations

  • Willingness to travel up to 40% to Rio de Janeiro, if not based locally.

description:
Estamos com oportunidade para vaga de Auxiliar de Manutenção!

Descrição das atividades:

  • Zelar pela manutenção, limpeza e conservação de todo material e equipamento sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Realizar o preenchimento dos chamados dentro do Sistema GLPI com informações de tarefas até a sua conclusão, para dar retorno ao requerente sobre o andamento dos serviços;
  • Executar manutenção de baixa complexidade na área elétrica (como troca de lâmpadas, interruptores, tomadas e outros) a fim de manter as instalações operacionais e em perfeitas condições de funcionamento, atendendo aos padrões e normas vigentes;
  • Auxiliar nos serviços de manutenção predial, elétrica, hidráulica, refrigeração e marcenaria, nas dependências das unidades, conforme demanda e orientação da chefia imediata;
  • Realizar atendimento imediato das solicitações de serviços, de acordo com a competência do cargo, para manutenção em todos os setores do Hospital, tomando as medidas de precaução com o uso dos EPI's corretos nos locais e tarefas que assim o exigirem;
  • Realizar consertos simples em cadeiras e camas hospitalares, como troca de rodízios e manivelas;
  • Utilizar, sob orientação, ferramentas e equipamentos apropriados para cada tipo de atividade, inclusive trabalhos em altura, fazendo uso dos acessórios de segurança exigidos, conforme legislação vigente;
  • Realizar organização do depósito quando solicitado;
  • Realizar transporte de materiais e equipamentos diversos, dentro do hospital e do depósito de bens patrimoniais para o HSRC e vice-versa;
  • Preencher corretamente as solicitações de serviços, indicando horário, data, número de patrimônio do bem e outras considerações sobre o serviço executado;
  • Trocar informações junto a Chefia Imediata quanto aos serviços executados, sobre o andamento e conclusão do mesmo, e solicitando compra de materiais quando necessário;
  • Realizar movimentação de bens patrimoniais, de acordo com a solicitação do setor de patrimônio e orientações da chefia imediata;
  • Cuidar da segurança dos usuários, pacientes e funcionários, durante a execução dos serviços de manutenção;
  • Limpar e organizar os locais onde foram realizados os serviços de manutenção, removendo entulhos, eliminando resíduos e manchas;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados nos serviços de manutenção, requisitando sua reposição quando necessário.

We're revolutionizing the fitness & wellness industry, and we’re looking for talented people to help us do it. Mindbody + ClassPass bring together the best of both sides of the market: Mindbody is the industry’s most trusted all-in-one technology platform; ClassPass is one of the most popular apps for fitness & self-care enthusiasts. Together we’re partnering with more than 70,000 fitness studios, gyms, salons, and spas around the world. We’re not just another tech company—we’re far and away the leader of our industry. So join the team, work with mission-led people, and enjoy amazing benefits. Let’s see what we can accomplish together!
Who we are
We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!
Your role
As a Software Engineer I, you’ll be a part of a team working to build secure systems for the Mindbody ecosystem. You’ll pursue continuous improvement to help Mindbody achieve its mission: Powering the world’s fitness and wellness businesses and connecting them with more consumers, more effectively, than anyone else.
You'll likely spend time working on

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and QA to iterate on the design, implementation and deployment of our product.
  • Build and maintain backend systems and applications, tightly scoped work with supervision and support.
  • Navigating code reviews thoughtfully and constructively contributing to conversations around pull requests.
  • Participating in retrospectives as a constructive team member.
  • Seek different perspectives and solicit honest feedback.
  • Practice engineering best practices (e.g., automated testing, code reviews, proper monitoring).
  • Learning one or more technical areas and becoming increasingly comfortable contributing to your team’s codebase.
  • Take delight in delighting our users.
  • Care about our studio partners and want to help them grow their business
About the right team member
You know the best platform is created through collaboration and iteration and you’re looking for the right opportunity, and the right team, to expand your experience. You seek feedback because it can turn good work into great work. You are naturally curious and enjoy learning from those around you. You're not afraid to ask questions early and often when navigating new code or systems. You take initiative to solve clearly defined problems, and you welcome constructive feedback as part of your growth. You strive to contribute positively to your team’s culture and take pride in doing thoughtful work.
At Mindbody+ClassPass we value people who are intellectually curious, who are pragmatic not dogmatic, and people who care about our product, their teammates, and their own personal growth. We are faced with an interesting set of technical challenges, and we believe in giving our engineers the autonomy to go and solve them. Much of our team comes from non-traditional computing backgrounds; we know that by bringing together a diverse set of voices we’ll be able to build a better product, and a better company. We care less about what languages or frameworks you know, and care more that you are excited to produce high-quality code and be constantly learning. Our engineers work in cross-functional teams that are focused on impact, and movement between teams is encouraged. We work very closely with our brilliant product team to deliver a world class user experience, and ultimately to empower our users to live their fullest, healthiest lives.

  • 0-2 years of experience in programming large-scale SaaS products.
  • Experience building backend services with an object-oriented language such as C# or Java.
  • Experience designing and architecting backend services.
  • Experience designing and working with Microservice architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring systems such as New Relic or Kibana.
  • Familiarity with SDLC and programming design patterns, and Agile methodology.
  • Experience reviewing new feature's impact on an application and recognizing potential risks.
  • Detail-oriented, professional and possesses a positive work attitude.
  • Ability to communicate professionally both verbally and in writing.
Technologies you'll be working with
  • Experience building highly performant and high-quality backends. We use Kotlin, .Net, Python, C#, React and Ruby in our stack but we're most interested in your experience building great systems.
  • Understanding of SQL and relational databases.

title: Pensions Lead Data Consultant
description:
Description

Great opportunity to join our Pensions Data Solutions Team as a Pensions Lead Data Consultant working hybrid based out of either London, Reigate, Bristol, Leeds, Manchester, Birmingham or our Edinburgh office.

Our data services span a broad range of clients with different UK pension administration operations and our solutions are delivered within the team, often in conjunction with other WTW businesses, or sometimes alongside third parties.

We have an increasing demand for individuals who understand the legacy Defined Benefit pension environment and the way that member data is held, processed, and used by pension administrators. We have a need for individuals with technical expertise to help develop and implement solutions for a wide range of pension schemes. The candidate will be client-facing and will work closely with technical leads, project managers, and other specialists within the team. They will be responsible for delivering quality Data Solutions services for our clients and will play a leading role in a range of technical projects, taking responsibility for successful delivery and implementation of the work. Excellence, client satisfaction, and good commercial outcomes are critical to our success.

The Role

  • As a client-facing project lead, you will work directly with our clients to understand their business requirements so that data solutions can be tailored to meet these objectives.
  • Deliver advice and a range of deliverables to Pension Managers, Trustee boards, and other key client contacts, liaising effectively across a variety of seniority levels with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Engage collaboratively with the Data Solutions leads and team members to deliver quality outcomes for clients.
  • Prepare effective data strategies, project approaches, and lead the team to deliver against the plan to meet the client’s key requirements.
  • Help improve and evolve processes and deliverables across Data Solutions service lines.
  • Build effective working relationships with administrators, actuaries, legal advisers, and client representatives.

In addition to client consulting, the candidate should be comfortable with business development and sales fundamentals and show aptitude and keenness to grow our business and develop their commercial skills. Candidates will need to pay close attention to the financial areas of our business including clear scoping, management of time and budgets, and adherence to established billing practices. You will be expected to promote best practices and bring new ideas to address client needs with a sharp business focus that helps maintain quality throughout the project life cycle. You will be self-motivated to meet deadlines on multiple client projects in a fast-moving environment.

What can we offer you?
The opportunity to further develop your skills, working in a fast-growing business as part of a diverse, dynamic, and collaborative team. In return, you will be rewarded with a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package including a pension scheme, life insurance, medical insurance, eye care vouchers, and flexible benefits including critical illness cover, dental cover, and many other options.

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • Advanced knowledge of UK Pension Scheme provisions and legislation.
  • An ability to tailor delivery of complex or technical materials to the audience; ensuring that key issues are presented in a clear, concise, and confident manner.
  • A proven track record in developing and managing several opportunities and projects simultaneously.
  • A demonstrable focus on client satisfaction, balanced with business needs.
  • Comfortable taking a proactive role to ensure client satisfaction through project work and willingness to grow new and existing client relationships.
  • Experience in leading and presenting at client meetings.
  • Experience in owning key financial areas of projects including pricing, scoping, and billing.
  • Knowledge of the role of the pensions administrator and the common UK administration systems.
  • A working knowledge of data and calculation auditing, cleansing, and different data correction projects.
  • Experience in GMP correction projects is preferable.
  • A good understanding of manual benefit calculations and processes.
  • A firm commitment to delivering high quality service.
  • Inquisitive, self-starter attitude and ability to work with ambiguity.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

At WTW, we believe difference makes us stronger. We want our workforce to reflect the different and varied markets we operate in and to build a culture of inclusivity that makes colleagues feel welcome, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive work environment throughout our organization. We embrace all types of diversity.

title: Customer Success Manager - Strategic Accounts (Tier 3)
description:
Customer Success Manager - Strategic Accounts (Tier 3)

Company Description
Fastmarkets is an industry-leading price-reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, offering price data, news, analytics, and events across agriculture, forest products, metals and mining, and new-generation energy markets.

Our data helps clients understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, facilitating trading and risk management. With a history dating back to 1865, Fastmarkets is a trusted global business with over 600 employees across the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Finland, and more.

Job Description
We are re-imagining how to better serve our customers and are seeking a dynamic Customer Success Manager to manage a portfolio of strategic clients. You will oversee a cross-commodity portfolio, ensuring a first-class customer experience.

Ideal candidates will have a strong background in managing large client accounts, building long-term relationships with senior stakeholders, and providing outstanding client management. A flexible mindset, innovative thinking, and solid business acumen are essential.

Your strategic mindset will enable you to proactively network within your accounts, gather insights on data usage, and conduct quarterly account reviews with the support of the Account Manager. You will identify gaps, upsell opportunities, and work to embed Fastmarkets’ products within client workflows. Face-to-face meetings and relationship-building are key components of this role.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with strategic accounts, acting as a trusted partner.
  • Support business growth by identifying cross-selling and upselling opportunities.
  • Visit key customers to establish goals and build relationships with stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client markets and delivering relevant insights.
  • Create workflow value maps to understand data usage across their business.
  • Hold in-depth conversations about pricing, data, and methodologies to build trust and handle objections.
  • Ensure quarterly account reviews are conducted throughout the client lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with Account Managers on strategies and account planning.
  • Identify and mitigate account risks, aiming to reduce churn.
  • Identify gaps, upsell opportunities, and expand user base within client organizations.
  • Embed additional Fastmarkets products within client workflows.
  • Maintain and update account plans, monitor usage, and improve engagement.
  • Gather customer feedback to inform product development and enhancements.
  • Coordinate with customer support to resolve technical issues promptly.
  • Create onboarding and training plans for new users and provide ad-hoc training as needed.
  • Stay updated on product releases and communicate changes to clients.
  • Build internal relationships across departments to ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Maintain high customer satisfaction levels and support case studies development.

KEY INTERFACES

  • Customer Adoption & Onboarding Team
  • Sales Team
  • Marketing Team
  • Product Team
  • Editorial Team
  • Customer Support Team

Qualifications

Knowledge, Experience And Skills

  • Minimum of 2 years in a SaaS Customer Success Manager role, preferably with product focus.
  • Customer-centric approach with proactive and self-organized mindset.
  • Experience with CRM systems, ideally Salesforce.
  • Knowledge of commodities (Agriculture, Forest, Metals & Mining, Battery Raw Materials) or similar fields like pricing or subscription services.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, curiosity, empathy, and high emotional intelligence.
  • Technical proficiency with Excel and knowledge of APIs is beneficial.
  • Strategic mindset, able to prioritize and steer away from firefighting.
  • Ownership of portfolio success metrics such as retention, satisfaction, and NPS.
  • Willingness to travel for client visits.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience in a global B2B environment.
  • Multiple language skills are a plus.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid model.

Additional Information

Our Values

Fastmarkets values diversity, inclusion, and a collaborative culture, driven by:

  • Metrics-driven insights
  • Accountability
  • Growth mindset
  • Inclusivity and respect
  • Customer centricity
  • Collaboration across teams

Opportunities are available in specific US states supporting hybrid work. For more details, see the US Hiring States map.
